items.title: Comparison ads are collected but never run
items.body: Several ads from other brands use side-by-side comparisons. None of our own ads do. A weight comparison would be an easy first test.

items.title: We lean on social proof and brand world
items.body: Most of our own ads use pro players or the Odin look. Humor, memes and myth-busting are untested by us.

items.title: Video is under-used for offers
items.body: Offer and price ads in the library are all stills. A short video version is worth a test.
